import java.util.*;
public class Prac {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int b = sc.nextInt();
        int[] a = new int[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            a[i] = sc.nextInt();
        }
        int[] cuts = new int[n];
        int j = 0;
        int even = 0;
        int odd = 0;
        int i = 0;
        while (i < n) {
            if ((a[i] & 1) == 0) {
                even++;
            } else {
                odd++;
            }
            if (even == odd && i != n - 1) {
                cuts[j++] = i + 1;
                even = 0;
                odd = 0;
            }
            i++;
        }
        int answer = 0;
        if (j > 1) {
            int[] costs = new int[j];
            for (int k = 0; k < j; k++) {
                int x = a[cuts[k]] - a[cuts[k] - 1];
                costs[k] = x < 0 ? -x : x;
            }
            Arrays.sort(costs);
            int sum = 0;
            for (int k = 0; k < j; k++) {
                if (sum + costs[k] <= b) {
                    sum += costs[k];
                    answer++;
                } else {
                    break;
                }
            }
        } else if (j == 1) {
            int x = a[cuts[0]] - a[cuts[0] - 1];
            if ((x < 0 ? -x : x) >= b) {
                answer = 1;
            }
        }
        System.out.println(answer);
    }
}
